**Finding: LD — compliant (preferred position met).**

No Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties exist in this Agreement:

- **§ 3 (Compensation)** — time-and-materials fees, expenses and taxes only; no late-payment interest, penalty or minimum-fee mechanic.
- **§ 6(a)** — either party may terminate for any or no reason on fifteen (15) days' notice, with no early-termination or cancellation fee.
- **§ 6(b) / § 7(c)** — on termination RadialSpark is paid only fees and expenses "incurred or earned … through the effective date," i.e. compensation for value actually delivered, not a stipulated or liquidated sum.
- **§ 7** — liability provisions are caps and exclusions running both ways; they contain no stipulated-damages formula.
- Targeted searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", termination/minimum fees, kill fees and "Company shall pay" returned no responsive language.

The Agreement therefore sits at the **preferred** position ("Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties"), and the fallback early-termination-fee cap is not needed. No redline proposed.
